scope: Actual git diff and current App/BattlePanel/ProgressTrack; relevant unchanged feedback/ReviewPages/strategy schema. Read-only source/evidence review only; no browser, test, source or Git modification.

sourceFindings.detail: While immersive and a real battle exists, the home main remains mounted and v-show removes it from layout when not hubMain. BattleStrategy local draft/view/page therefore survive ordinary detail and main-feature navigation. On actual battle null the BattlePanel branch unmounts; existing runId/enemy/trialStage watchers still reset actual context. No Store start or clock call was introduced.

Hidden home removes game-content id. currentContent now chooses only visibleFocusTarget catalogue nodes and only a visible contentPanel fallback, so hidden retained battle is not a focus fallback. Display:none descendants are not ordinary clickable/focusable targets. This is source review, not actual keyboard/pixel acceptance.

App passes active=hubMain through BattlePanel to ProgressTrack. Watch clears timer/change and closes progress dialog on active false and false→true, as well as identity/max change. Hidden HP updates cannot retain local change; inspect checks active before and after nextTick, preventing an old pending progress dialog from opening after hide. Numeric values, ratios and formal Game remain unchanged.

Historical rows read the actual saved version6 plan. Single battle includes original enemy/trialStage/action/max1 and3-second scope. Auto battle includes enemy/trialStage/maxCycles/mpBudget, all11 strategy fields. Encounter includes maxEncounters/monthBudget/remainingMonthsReserve/target item/quantity as well as full shared strategy. Finished/different-target battle and encounter now outside original location route to the readonly activity surface. No start/replay/confirm action exists in those rows.

Move names use a fixed move map, not current loadout names, stats or a new preview. ReviewPages identity is activity.runId+activity.id, excluding ordinary Game/activity revision and completedCycles. Thus same-activity cycle commits recompute rows without resetting the page; actual activity replacement resets visible mode and reading identity.

Configuration intent/snapshot/stale/activity CAS/retry branches are unchanged. Cached read-only plans do not hold command IDs or replace the accepted write intent; same-command retry still bypasses new-intent stale check and calls retryFor(original commandId). No diff in full rules, Store, configuration-persistence, ReviewPages or focus.ts was present during review.

remainingTargetedRisk.title: Actor CSS marks can outlive visibility now that the battle DOM is retained
remainingTargetedRisk.detail: ActionFeedbackStage.clear(), called on viewKey/playfieldActive change, clears global notice/motion/floats but does not remove classes stored in marks. actor-impact/actor-arrival/scene-arrival are retained on the actual actor/scene element for650ms. Previously unmount removed that DOM; v-show retention can leave the class and possibly resume/restart its CSS animation when returning within that window.
minimalCheck: Finish one visible nonterminal battle turn and verify an actor CSS impact/arrival class was genuinely applied.
Open an ordinary detail before the class cleanup timeout and return before650ms.
Require no old actor/scene transient class or impact replay on return, while full Game/activity/current command identity remain unchanged from the actual authorized turn.
remainingTargetedRisk.boundedFixIfConfirmed: Clear only actor-impact/actor-arrival/scene-arrival presentation marks on context hide/change. Do not clear accepted command/receipt/retry identity or alter timing/rewards. Global notice/floats and ProgressTrack local change already have their separate reset logic.
